Definition: from G2596 and the base of G2830; to dash (wash) down, i.e. (by implication) to deluge:--overflow.
BiblicalUsage: The world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the first world drowned so the second would know that God judges, and the next judgment will be by fire.
